answer: Each applicant drills one numbered ice core from a tundra lake, and the warden photographs its bands and logs its weight before sealing it in a cold case. At dawn a neighbor signs the log as raven tracks cross the snow. Twice a season the warden reweighs the core and checks its bands. A swapped core shows a gap in weight or bands, and the forgery forfeits a 150 token deposit. Faking 10,000 cores freezes 1,500,000 tokens and costs 950,000 dollars. A library files one winter per shelf. A missing winter leaves a gap the librarian spots, and the shelf stays empty until the forger pays.
